ShipperDashboard.title: Shipper Dashboard
ShipperDashboard.create_shipment_desc: Post a shipment request to the marketplace and receive transporter offers.
ShipperDashboard.not_shipper_desc: This area is available to authenticated marketplace members with the SHIPPER role. Your current membership does not grant access.
ShipperDashboard.shipments_subtitle: Every shipment you have created, across all lifecycle states.
ShipperDashboard.empty_shipments_desc: Create your first shipment to publish it to the marketplace and start receiving transporter offers.
ShipperDashboard.cancel_confirm: Cancel this shipment? This cannot be undone.
ShipperDashboard.new_shipment_subtitle: Publish a shipment request to the marketplace. Fields marked required follow the MOD-001 canonical shipment model.
ShipperDashboard.field_description_placeholder: Cargo description, handling requirements, supporting information
ShipperDashboard.vehicles_hint: Select every vehicle type you would accept for this shipment. Transporter offers are checked against this list before a booking can be initiated.
ShipperDashboard.validation_origin: Origin requires an address, latitude and longitude.
ShipperDashboard.validation_destination: Destination requires an address, latitude and longitude.
ShipperDashboard.validation_weight_or_volume: Provide at least a weight or a volume.
ShipperDashboard.validation_time_window: Earliest pickup and latest delivery are required, and pickup must not be after delivery.
ShipperDashboard.offers_empty: No transporter offers have been submitted for this shipment yet.
ShipperDashboard.offers_hint: All valid offers are shown. Selection is always yours — the platform never chooses a transporter for you.
ShipperDashboard.matching_desc: Runs the NexCargo matching engine against the offers submitted for this shipment. Results are advisory.
ShipperDashboard.matching_advisory_notice: AI recommendations are advisory only. They never select a transporter, accept an offer, create a booking or commit you to a transaction.
ShipperDashboard.matching_empty: No eligible offers were found for this shipment.
ShipperDashboard.matching_relaxed: No offer satisfied every mandatory requirement. The engine applied relaxation steps to explain the gap.
ShipperDashboard.matching_requires_published: Matching runs only on published shipments.
ShipperDashboard.matching_error: Could not run the matching engine.
ShipperDashboard.booking_desc: Initiating a booking records your selection as REQUESTED. The transporter must still accept, and the contract and financial authorisations follow the established lifecycle.
ShipperDashboard.booking_notice: This step does not confirm the booking, does not generate or sign a contract, and does not trigger any payment or escrow action.
ShipperDashboard.booking_requires_offer: Select a transporter offer before initiating a booking.
ShipperDashboard.booking_requires_published: A booking can only be initiated from a published shipment.
ShipperDashboard.not_found_desc: This shipment does not exist or is not visible to your account.
ShipperDashboard.bookings_subtitle: Bookings you have initiated, with their current lifecycle state.
ShipperDashboard.empty_bookings_desc: Bookings appear here once you select a transporter offer and initiate the authorised booking workflow.
ShipperDashboard.error_boundary_desc: This section could not be loaded. Your data has not been changed.
ShipperDashboard.edit_shipment_subtitle: Update the details of this draft shipment. Only a shipment in draft can be edited.
ShipperDashboard.edit_locked_title: This shipment can no longer be edited
ShipperDashboard.edit_locked_desc: Only shipments in draft can be changed. Once a shipment is published it belongs to the marketplace and its details are fixed.

TransporterDashboard.title: Transporter dashboard
TransporterDashboard.overview: Your fleet, quotations, booking requests and active operations.
TransporterDashboard.not_transporter_desc: The account you are signed in with does not hold a TRANSPORTER marketplace membership, so the transporter workspace is not available to it.
TransporterDashboard.error_boundary_desc: We could not load this page. Please try again.
TransporterDashboard.outstanding_empty: Nothing needs your attention right now.
TransporterDashboard.outstanding_setup_fleet: Register your first fleet so you can list vehicles and drivers.
TransporterDashboard.outstanding_add_vehicle: Add a vehicle to your fleet so quotations can state real capacity.
TransporterDashboard.outstanding_process_bookings: You have booking requests waiting to be processed.
TransporterDashboard.outstanding_quotations_awaiting: Some quotations are still awaiting a shipper response.
TransporterDashboard.outstanding_reactivate_fleet: None of your fleets is operationally active.
TransporterDashboard.no_booking_requests_hint: A shipper creates a booking request after accepting one of your quotations.
TransporterDashboard.no_quotations: You have not quoted a shipment yet.
TransporterDashboard.no_quotations_hint: Browse the published opportunities and submit a quotation.
TransporterDashboard.fleet_empty: No vehicle is registered to your fleet yet.
TransporterDashboard.no_notifications: No notifications for this account yet.
TransporterDashboard.fleet_intro: Register your fleets and the vehicles that carry them. You see and change only the fleet that belongs to this account.
TransporterDashboard.no_fleets_hint: A fleet holds your vehicles and drivers. Register your first fleet to continue.
TransporterDashboard.no_vehicles_in_fleet: No vehicles registered in this fleet yet.
TransporterDashboard.create_fleet_hint: A fleet is linked to your transporter account and only you can manage it.
TransporterDashboard.register_vehicle_needs_fleet: Register a fleet first — a vehicle always belongs to one of your fleets.
TransporterDashboard.mozambique_licence_hint: A licence issued in Mozambique is valid nationwide, so this stays enabled for Mozambique-registered vehicles.
TransporterDashboard.drivers_intro: The drivers in your fleet register. A driver is a record of your operation — not a marketplace account.
TransporterDashboard.register_driver_hint: A driver belongs to one of your fleets and is never a marketplace member. Linking a driver to a platform account is done through delegation, not here.
TransporterDashboard.register_driver_needs_fleet: Register a fleet first — a driver always belongs to one of your fleets.
TransporterDashboard.profile_intro: The operating identity carried by your fleet register. Account and membership details come from your account and are managed there.
TransporterDashboard.no_fleet_profile_hint: Your business profile is built from your fleets. Register a fleet to set a name, region and status.
TransporterDashboard.edit_fleet_hint: Changes apply to this fleet only and take effect immediately.
TransporterDashboard.opportunities_intro: Published shipments checked against your own available vehicles.
TransporterDashboard.opportunities_outside_empty: Every published shipment matches at least one of your available vehicles.
TransporterDashboard.no_opportunities: No published shipment currently matches your available vehicles.
TransporterDashboard.no_opportunities_hint: Add a vehicle to your fleet, or check back after shippers publish new shipments.
TransporterDashboard.fleet_missing_hint: You have no available vehicles, so no shipment can be marked eligible yet.
TransporterDashboard.opportunity_not_found: This shipment is not available to quote.
TransporterDashboard.opportunity_none_match: None of your available vehicles satisfy the hard filters for this shipment.
TransporterDashboard.opportunity_already_quoted_notice: You already have a quotation for this shipment.
TransporterDashboard.quote_prepare_intro: A quotation tells the shipper what you would charge and when you can move the cargo. It does not book the shipment.
TransporterDashboard.validation_price: Enter a price proposal greater than zero.
TransporterDashboard.validation_vehicle: Select one of your available vehicles.
TransporterDashboard.validation_availability: Earliest pickup, latest pickup and estimated delivery are required.
TransporterDashboard.validation_availability_order: The availability window must run from earlier to later.
TransporterDashboard.time_window_advisory: Matching rejects quotations whose availability window cannot meet the shipper’s pickup or delivery dates.
TransporterDashboard.advisory_notice: Advisory only. The range comes from the MOD-001 corridor pricing model; the price you submit is yours.
TransporterDashboard.advisory_unavailable: This shipment lacks the weight or time-window data the advisory model needs.
TransporterDashboard.opportunity_not_eligible: No available vehicle meets the weight, volume or cargo-type requirements.
TransporterDashboard.quotation_listing_closed: This shipment is no longer published.
TransporterDashboard.quotations_intro: Every quotation you have submitted, with the shipper’s decision.
TransporterDashboard.quotation_amend_notice: A submitted quotation cannot be edited. Withdraw it and submit a new one.
TransporterDashboard.quotation_terminal: The shipper has already decided on this quotation.
TransporterDashboard.bookings_intro: Bookings the shipper has initiated from your quotations, with the state of each contract.
TransporterDashboard.bookings_awaiting_empty: No contract is waiting for your signature.
TransporterDashboard.bookings_empty_desc: The shipper creates a booking request after accepting one of your quotations. Submit a quotation to start.
TransporterDashboard.contract_accept_confirm: Sign this contract as the transporter? Your acceptance is recorded against your account.
TransporterDashboard.booking_not_found: This booking is not available to your account.
TransporterDashboard.quotation_not_visible: The quotation selected for this booking is not visible to your account.
TransporterDashboard.contract_accept_notice: The shipper has confirmed this booking and generated the contract. Your acceptance is the transporter signature; the contract becomes active once both parties have signed.
TransporterDashboard.contract_awaiting_shipper: You have signed. The contract is waiting for the shipper’s signature.
TransporterDashboard.booking_confirm_notice: No contract exists yet. The shipper must confirm the booking before a contract is generated and before you can sign it.
TransporterDashboard.booking_decline_notice: Declining a booking is not available to transporters in the current workflow. Contact the shipper, or let the request lapse — only the shipper can cancel a booking.
TransporterDashboard.booking_operations_notice: The contract is active, so this booking is in operations.
TransporterDashboard.operations_not_initialised: The tracking record for this booking has not been created yet. Operations become available once the shipment is registered for tracking.
TransporterDashboard.documents_empty: No documents are linked to this booking or contract.
TransporterDashboard.documents_read_only_notice: Documents are read-only here. Upload and validation are handled by the document workflow.
TransporterDashboard.operations_intro: Confirmed bookings you are carrying, with their tracking state.
TransporterDashboard.operations_active_empty: No operation is active right now.
TransporterDashboard.operations_closed_empty: No operation has been completed or cancelled.
TransporterDashboard.operations_empty_desc: An operation appears here once a booking is confirmed and its shipment is registered for tracking.
TransporterDashboard.operation_not_found: This operation is not available to your account.
TransporterDashboard.operation_pickup_proof_notice: Pickup is recorded by moving the shipment to Awaiting pickup and then Pickup acknowledged. NexCargo has no separate proof-of-pickup artefact, so no photograph or signature is captured at pickup.
TransporterDashboard.operation_financial_notice: Payment, escrow and settlement are system-controlled. Nothing on this page triggers or confirms them.
TransporterDashboard.operation_no_assignments: No vehicle or driver is assigned to this operation yet.
TransporterDashboard.operation_no_events: No milestone has been recorded yet.
TransporterDashboard.pod_none: No proof of delivery has been submitted.
TransporterDashboard.pod_not_yet_available: Proof of delivery can be submitted once the shipment reaches Delivered or Completed.
TransporterDashboard.pod_verification_notice: Verification is a platform governance action. Submitting evidence does not verify it and does not complete the shipment.
TransporterDashboard.operation_no_transitions: This shipment is in a final state, so no further status change is allowed.
TransporterDashboard.operation_status_updated: The shipment status has been updated.
TransporterDashboard.assignment_needs_assets: Register a vehicle or a driver in your fleet before assigning assets to an operation.
TransporterDashboard.validation_assignment_asset: Select a vehicle, a driver, or both.
TransporterDashboard.validation_assignment_window: The scheduled start must not be later than the scheduled end.
TransporterDashboard.validation_pod_recipient: Enter the name of the person who received the cargo.
TransporterDashboard.validation_pod_photos: Add at least one photograph reference.
TransporterDashboard.pod_submitted: The proof of delivery has been submitted for verification.
TransporterDashboard.field_pod_reference_placeholder: Storage reference of the captured signature
TransporterDashboard.pod_evidence_hint: References must point at objects already stored in NexCargo. This form records evidence; it does not upload files.

Home.hero_subtitle: Cargo Posted. Right Transport. Deal Closed.
Home.hero_body: The digital marketplace that connects shippers and transporters in one place. Artificial Intelligence finds the right transport for every load — and vice versa. Freight payment is made directly into an Escrow Account managed by a partner bank. Post cargo, negotiate, track your freight in real time, make payments and receive funds securely — without intermediaries or unnecessary complexity.
Home.product_demo_desc: Browse representative listings from the NexCargo marketplace. Create an account to interact with real cargo opportunities.
Home.how_step_shipper_1_desc: Enter origin, destination, cargo type, weight, and preferred date.
Home.how_step_shipper_2_desc: Transporters discover your cargo and submit their price proposals.
Home.how_step_shipper_3_desc: Review the offers, accept the best option, and proceed to contracting.
Home.how_step_transporter_1_desc: Explore available cargo that matches your route and capacity.
Home.how_step_transporter_2_desc: Propose your prices for cargo compatible with your vehicle.
Home.how_step_transporter_3_desc: Sign the contract, move cargo, deliver, and get paid.
Home.for_shipper_desc: Post cargo with complete route and date details. Receive price proposals from transporters, compare options, and proceed through structured contracting flows, all through your personalized Dashboard.
Home.shipper_features_compare: Compare and select the best offer
Home.for_transporter_desc: Discover cargo that matches your preferred routes and vehicle capacity. Submit your price proposals, get hired, and manage your operations, all through your personalized Dashboard.
Home.feature_listings_desc: Post and manage cargo with complete route, weight, preferred date, and vehicle requirement details.
Home.feature_matching_desc: Connects cargo requirements with suitable transport capacity based on route, capacity, and reliability.
Home.feature_tracking_desc: Track your shipment's location, route, and status in real time with live GPS tracking from departure to delivery.
Home.feature_payment_desc: The Shipper pays directly into the Escrow Account managed by the partner bank, using available payment methods. The funds are released after delivery is confirmed.
Home.feature_ai_desc: AI-supported decision assistance for freight matching, routing suggestions, and operational optimization.
Home.feature_documents_desc: Documents integrated into cargo, contracting, and operational workflows, including electronic delivery orders and compliance records.
Home.feature_notifications_desc: Operational communication throughout the transport lifecycle — from posting through delivery confirmation.
Home.feature_multilang_desc: Full Portuguese and English interface supporting logistics operations in Mozambique and the region.
Home.trust_no_custody_desc: We connect market participants without interfering in the operation. We are the technology layer for logistics coordination, not a carrier.
Home.trust_responsibility_desc: Transport execution and management belong exclusively to the Transporter. NexCargo provides the digital infrastructure; the fleet belongs to the operator.
Home.trust_no_custody_funds_desc: NexCargo does not hold customer funds. The financial architecture processes funds exclusively through duly regulated banking and payment partners.
Home.trust_region_desc: Built from the ground up for the logistics realities of Mozambique, with a native Portuguese interface and architecture prepared for the regional SADC corridors.
Home.moz_title: Built in Mozambique. Designed for the region.
Home.moz_desc: NexCargo was built to address the logistics challenges of Mozambique and the needs of transport corridors across Southern Africa. The platform provides a native Portuguese experience and is designed to support domestic and cross-border transport operations across the SADC region.
Home.final_section_title: Ready to move your first cargo?
Home.final_shipper_line: Publish your cargo and reach qualified transporters.
Home.final_transporter_line: Discover new freight opportunities along your routes.
Home.footer_brand_desc: A neutral freight marketplace built for Mozambique and the SADC region.
